title: Use the Greentic Wizard Launcher
summary: Expose repository wizards through greentic-dev launcher commands while preserving schema and answers contracts.

modules.title: Define the Launcher Contract
modules.objective: Make wizard schema, answers, and apply modes available through greentic-dev.

steps.instruction: Expose the repository wizard schema through the launcher.
steps.expected_output: The launcher prints the current wizard schema.

steps.instruction: Run the wizard through a checked answers file.
steps.expected_output: The launcher delegates to the owning repo wizard.

deprecated_commands.reason: Agents should use the launcher so schema and answers contracts are stable.
